funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage in their career. Applicants must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals seeking to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any career stage; higher tiers require postdoctoral level or equivalent experience. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research travel and/or address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start or already undertaking a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture at a UK institution.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for students beginning or continuing master’s or doctoral studies in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students (undergraduate level and above) of any nationality researching eighteenth- or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports research trips to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the 18th‑19th centuries.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals with an offer of a master’s degree place at a UK institution, commencing between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a one‑year (or part‑time two‑year) master’s degree that brings new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals with an offer of a doctorate at a UK university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants eligible for the same award amount.
opportunities.summary: Provides full funding (fees and living costs) for a three‑year doctoral programme in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level or with equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Supports individuals to undertake a major research project that reshapes understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised experts.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium for research on British‑Italian topics.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to organisations to support original and insightful research in British art.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to organisations to support costs of exhibition publications showcasing new research.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations in publishing exhibition catalogues and related materials.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to organisations aiming to disseminate research through events and programming.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to host events that disseminate research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to organisations to support vital conservation research on items from their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for conservation research projects within organisations.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to organisations to support digitisation projects on material from their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations in digitising collections related to British art.
